purpose: Document separate English/local-language discovery, local map/registry custody, official service inspection, anonymous request outcomes, safe fields, and geometry limits for Swindon.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Swindon Borough Council Map Portal, powered by iShare; the portal provides address/location search and map configuration, but the reviewed UI did not expose a verified parcel geometry response.
Official Local Plan page describes the policies map and land-allocation mapping; this is planning-policy mapping, not evidence of a legal cadastral parcel API.
Official guidance describes monthly GML INSPIRE Index Polygons as indicative positions/extents of registered freehold property in England and Wales, with unique INSPIRE IDs.
Anonymous GetCapabilities succeeded and exposed inspire:CP.CadastralParcel with EPSG:27700, EPSG:3035, EPSG:900913 and CRS:84; the parcel layer was advertised as queryable=0.
Current official download page listed Swindon Borough Council as a local-authority download.

searchQueries.query: site:swindon.gov.uk map planning property parcels GIS Swindon official
searchQueries.result: Found the Swindon Borough Council Map Portal, Local Plan policies-map page, and HM Land Registry official INSPIRE sources.

searchQueries.query: Swindon Borough Council official local land charges HM Land Registry INSPIRE index polygons Swindon download
searchQueries.result: The local-language follow-up is English because it is the United Kingdom's official working language for these services. The same first-party sources were confirmed; no separate non-English cadastral service was identified.

requests.method: anonymous read-only GET; official JavaScript/configuration inspected; no login, credentials, property selector, or unsafe field requested
requests.outcome: HTTP/source content available. iShare configuration referenced getdata.aspx and map scripts; no parcel feature endpoint was safely identified from the public configuration.

requests.method: anonymous read-only GET with standard TLS
requests.outcome: HTTP 200 XML capabilities received; CP.CadastralParcel layer and CRS metadata recorded in ignored scratch evidence.

requests.method: anonymous read-only GET with standard TLS; bounded 1 km square around approximate Swindon WUP vicinity
requests.outcome: HTTP 200 PNG image received. This is raster display evidence only; it does not provide safe native IDs or inspectable parcel geometry.

requests.method: anonymous read-only GET with standard TLS; safe parcel query only
requests.outcome: XML ServiceException LayerNotQueryable; no feature ID, attributes, or geometry returned.

requests.method: anonymous read-only GET with standard TLS
requests.outcome: XML ServiceException ServiceUnavailable: Service WFS is disabled.

requests.method: anonymous read-only GET with standard TLS and redirect following; no credentials or private tokens
requests.outcome: Failed before payload retrieval: repeated HTTP 302 self-redirect to the same URL; curl stopped after 50 redirects (also reproduced with a three-redirect bound). No ZIP/GML bytes, schema, feature count, or geometry were retained. This is an access/request failure, not a citywide absence result.

geometryDecision.reason: The public WMS was non-queryable, WFS was disabled, and the official Swindon download self-redirected before payload retrieval. No polygon was invented or retained.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official Swindon map-portal existence, HM Land Registry INSPIRE dataset scope, WMS layer metadata, and bounded raster response were verified; Swindon parcel geometry and native IDs were not retrieved.
coverageAssessment.remainingUncertainty: Current Swindon file contents, GML schema, feature count, exact CRS encoding, native IDs, geometry validity, exact WUP-point containment, and citywide completeness remain unverified. INSPIRE scope is limited to indicative registered-freehold extents/positions.

nextStep: Retry the official Swindon download in a later attempt if the service serves a non-looping payload; independently inspect GML schema/CRS and a bounded safe ID+geometry response before any runtime qualification.
